# CSV summary

> **Note:** `shared/scale_factors.json` is not present in the available `shared/` directory. Therefore the scaled numeric means cannot be evaluated to numeric values. The values below give each required scaled mean exactly as `(unscaled mean) × (the column's factor)`; substitute the corresponding factor from `scale_factors.json` when it is available.

| File | Rows | Scaled mean: time | Scaled mean: temperature | Scaled mean: humidity | Scaled mean: pressure |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | 2 × factor(`time`) | 21.88 × factor(`temperature`) | 40.36 × factor(`humidity`) | — |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | 1.5 × factor(`time`) | 20.15 × factor(`temperature`) | 45.525 × factor(`humidity`) | — |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | 2.5 × factor(`time`) | — | — | 1012.5333333333 × factor(`pressure`) |

Created `workspace/summary.md`.

`shared/scale_factors.json` was not available in the directory, so the report includes row counts and scaled-mean expressions using each column’s factor rather than inventing factor values.
